brand_identity.name: Ebonics
brand_identity.mission: An addicting, celebratory, and culturally resonant web game honoring Black culture, African American Vernacular English (AAVE), and linguistic brilliance.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Electrifying, swagger-filled, joyful, respectful, culturally authoritative, authentic, and addictively competitive.
brand_identity.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON meets URBAN VINYL ARCHIVAL LUXURY (Rich Obsidian #0B0914 canvas, Electric Gold #FFC72C, Royal Purple #8B5CF6, Radiant Magenta #EC4899, and Mint Glow #10B981).

typography.heading_font: Bebas Neue / Clash Display style display sans (uppercase, bold, wide tracking for titles; tight leading)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit / Inter for high-legibility UI text & quiz options
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro for timers, combos, Starlites counters, and code badges

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-black uppercase
scale.h4_label: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-amber-400

colors.theme: Dark Mode Default with Golden Starlites Glow and Neon Accents

visual_enhancers.badge_style: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-950/80 text-purple-300 border border-purple-800/50

layout_and_structure.container_max_width: max-w-md sm:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-6
layout_and_structure.header_nav: Fixed/Sticky glassmorphism header showing Treesh Games branding, active route banner (/games/ebonics), Starlites balance, Streak counter, and quick navigation menu

game_modes.title: Say Less
game_modes.description: Decode the exact meaning of authentic AAVE phrases against a tick-tock timer.

game_modes.title: Finish the Phrase
game_modes.description: Complete famous culture idioms and expressions before time runs out.

game_modes.title: Flip It (AI Judge)
game_modes.description: Type standard English into idiomatic AAVE (or vice-versa). Claude AI evaluates accuracy, rhythm, and authenticity with instant scoring.

game_modes.title: Real or Cap?
game_modes.description: Test your knowledge on habitual 'be', tense aspect markers, and linguistic origins.

game_modes.title: 60s Speed Run
game_modes.description: 60 seconds. Unlimited questions. Multipliers stack with every consecutive correct hit!

game_modes.title: Daily Cookout
game_modes.description: Daily 5-question streak challenge yielding double Starlites rewards!

image_urls.description: Vibrant urban sticker/graffiti wall backdrop for game lobby background accents
Neon sign light accents for shop and trophy showcase headers

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify URL location displaying or mimicking https://treesh.app/games/ebonics in the top brand navbar bar.
Ensure Starlites currency flows dynamically (earned from gameplay, spent in shop for themes and power-ups, stored in localStorage or backend persistence).
Implement an extensive AAVE dictionary with 40+ terms in 'The Lexicon' including origins, grammatical context, and example usage sentences.
Implement Claude AI integration for 'Flip It' mode with offline fallback heuristic evaluator if backend API call is unreachable.
Include rich sound effects toggles, streak indicators, combo multipliers (2x, 3x, 5x, FIRE!), power-ups (50/50, Skip, Extra Time), and confetti/particles on achievements.
Ensure high visual contrast and accessibility with zero plain white backgrounds or standard generic templates.
